Name: Hazor in the Negev
Description: A town named in Judah's southern town list, between Kedesh and Ithnan, in the Negev allotment — a different Hazor from the great northern city Joshua burned.
BiblicalSignificance: Its only appearance is the allotment list of Joshua 15; it shows how the same town name recurs in Judah's south, far from the northern Hazor of the conquest wars.
